title: BEACH Parameter File
description: Schema for BEACH beach.toml files, including direct Fortran runtime keys and Fortran-normalized high-level authoring keys. Use with TOML-aware editors such as Even Better TOML / Taplo.

domain.description: Finite box geometry and periodic topology.

particle_boundary.description: Default tracked-particle action on nonperiodic box faces.

max_nonzero_mode_potential_step.description: Maximum accepted change of the cached k!=0 potential at panel centroids [V]. When set, batch_duration is the maximum trial duration and rejected trials are retraced at successive factors of 1/2.

mode.description: Field boundary closure. periodic2 normally requires field_solver=fmm; the direct triangle_p0 panel_spectral_reference split model is the validation-only exception.

positiveVec2.description: 2-component vector [x, y] with all positive values.

positiveVec3.description: 3-component vector [x, y, z] with all positive values.

sizeFraction.description: Box-relative template size. Shape depends on template kind.

placementMode.description: High-level placement mode normalized by the Fortran config loader.

surfaceSide.description: Physical vacuum side relative to ordered triangle winding.

scaleReference.description: Box dimension used as a high-level mesh group scale reference.

particleBoundaryAction.description: Tracked-particle action on a nonperiodic face. reflect reverses only the normal velocity. redistributed_reflect additionally resamples the tangential position uniformly on the face while preserving tangential velocity.

speciesParticleBoundary.description: Per-species overrides of global particle-boundary actions.

speciesParticleBoundaryAction.description: Per-species action; inherit uses the global particle boundary. redistributed_reflect is a normal-velocity reflection with uniform tangential-position redistribution.

speciesBoundaryInflow.description: Per-species reservoir inflow attached to complete nonperiodic box faces.

injectFace.description: Box face identifier for particle injection.

batch_duration.description: Batch duration [s]. Mutually exclusive with batch_duration_step.

tol_rel.description: Monitoring metric; not an early-stop condition.

e0.description: Uniform external electric field vector [V/m]. Mutually exclusive with e0_abs/e0_phi_*.

e0_abs.description: Magnitude of the uniform external electric field [V/m].

e0_phi_xy_deg.description: Azimuth angle of e0 in the x-y plane [deg]. Requires e0_abs.

e0_phi_z_deg.description: Elevation angle of e0 from the x-y plane [deg]. Requires e0_abs.

field_normalization.description: Length normalization used internally by field solvers.

field_periodic_image_layers.description: Nearby image layers for periodic2. Computes [-N, N] finite image sum per periodic axis.

field_periodic_far_correction.description: Far-field correction mode for periodic2. cached_kneq0 reuses a versioned nonzero-mode operator.

field_periodic_ewald_alpha.description: Ewald splitting parameter for cached_kneq0 operator generation. 0 = auto-determined from box size.

field_periodic_ewald_layers.description: Ewald real-space/reciprocal shell depth for cached_kneq0 operator generation.

field_periodic_generation_tolerance.description: Generation tolerance included in the periodic operator cache identity.

tree_leaf_max.description: Maximum elements per leaf node in treecode/FMM.

tree_min_nelem.description: Element count threshold for field_solver=auto to switch to treecode.

multiple_box_events_policy.description: Action when one particle step exceeds the internal box-boundary event limit. soft_discard records and removes only that particle.

multiple_box_events_soft_discard_count_l.description: Cumulative recorded soft-discard count above which the run aborts.

multiple_box_events_soft_discard_abs_cha.description: Cumulative absolute macro-particle charge [C] above which the run aborts.

raycast_max_bounce.description: Maximum bounce count for photo_raycast ray tracing.

species.description: List of particle species (at least one required).

species_key.description: Stable species identifier used by restart fingerprints; defaults to species_<1-based index>.

npcls_per_step.description: Macro-particles generated per batch for volume_seed.

number_density_cm3.description: Reservoir density [cm^-3] for reservoir_face, plane_source, or boundary_inflow.

number_density_m3.description: Reservoir density [m^-3] for reservoir_face, plane_source, or boundary_inflow.

target_macro_particles_per_batch.description: For flux-driven reservoir injection, either the total macro-particle target across all enabled inflow faces or a plane source, or -1 to reuse species[1] weight.

source_normal.description: Non-zero axis-aligned normal for plane_source injection; normalized internally.

velocity_distribution.description: Velocity distribution model. grid is available for flux-driven reservoir injection.

velocity_grid_path.description: CSV file with columns vx_m_s,vy_m_s,vz_m_s,f for velocity_distribution=grid. Complete rectilinear grids are sampled with trilinear interpolation; other inputs fall back to discrete row sampling.

velocity_grid_pdf_kind.description: Interpretation of f in velocity_grid_path. phase_space samples v_n f(v); flux_weighted treats f as the incoming flux-weighted distribution.

velocity_grid_sampling.description: Sampling mode for velocity_distribution=grid. auto tries rectilinear trilinear interpolation and falls back to discrete rows; rectilinear requires a complete rectilinear grid; discrete samples CSV rows directly.

current_density_a_m2.description: Incoming current density [A/m^2] for velocity_distribution=grid. Mutually exclusive with particle_flux_m2_s.

rays_per_batch.description: Ray count per batch for photo_raycast.

deposit_opposite_charge_on_emit.description: Deposit opposite-sign charge on emitting element for photo_raycast.

normal_drift_speed.description: Surface-normal drift speed [m/s] for photo_raycast emission.

ray_direction.description: Ray direction vector for photo_raycast. Defaults to inward face normal.

inject_face.description: Injection face. Required for reservoir_face and photo_raycast.

boundary.description: Optional per-species overrides for all six nonperiodic faces.

boundary_inflow.description: Reservoir inflow attached to full nonperiodic simulation-boundary faces.

surface_charge_closure.description: Surface-charge treatment for this species. explicit commits tracked outcomes directly. neutral_return rescales resolved negative photoelectron returns so emission plus return has zero net surface charge; it requires negative photo_raycast, opposite-charge emission deposit, and reflect or redistributed_reflect on inject_face.

inject_region_mode.description: High-level injection-region mode. face_fraction resolves uv_low/uv_high into pos_low/pos_high.

uv_low.description: Lower [u, v] range on inject_face for inject_region_mode="face_fraction".

uv_high.description: Upper [u, v] range on inject_face for inject_region_mode="face_fraction".

mode.description: Mesh input method. auto selects obj if obj_path exists, otherwise template.

surface_model.description: Surface response model assigned to OBJ mesh elements. All surface sources use the implicit triangle_p0 discretization. conductor uses floating equipotential charge redistribution for field_boundary.mode=free; dielectric is metadata-only in the current release. Template meshes use per-template surface_model instead.

surface_side.description: Vacuum side for OBJ panels. Required by the implicit triangle_p0 panel kernel.

epsilon_r.description: Relative permittivity assigned to OBJ mesh elements. Stored for all surface models; dielectric polarization is not solved in the current release.

obj_scale.description: OBJ読み込み後に適用する一様スケーリング係数

obj_rotation.description: OBJ読み込み後に適用する回転角 [度]。x→y→z 外因性回転 (Rz·Ry·Rx)

obj_offset.description: OBJ読み込み後に適用する平行移動 [m]

groups.description: High-level named mesh groups that provide a common origin and scale for templates.

offset.description: Offset [m] added to the group origin.

offset_frac.description: Box-size-relative offset added to the group origin.

scale.description: Absolute group scale factor for local template coordinates and lengths.

scale_from.description: Box dimension used with scale_factor to compute group scale.

surface_model.description: Surface response model assigned to elements generated from this template. All surface sources use the implicit triangle_p0 discretization. conductor uses floating equipotential charge redistribution for field_boundary.mode=free; dielectric is metadata-only in the current release.

surface_side.description: Vacuum side for this template. Required when enabled by the implicit triangle_p0 panel kernel.

epsilon_r.description: Relative permittivity assigned to elements generated from this template. Stored for all surface models; dielectric polarization is not solved in the current release.

cap.description: Enable both end caps for cylinder.

cap_top.description: Enable top end cap for cylinder (overrides cap).

cap_bottom.description: Enable bottom end cap for cylinder (overrides cap).

offset.description: Offset [m] added to the anchored template center.

offset_frac.description: Box-size-relative offset added to the anchored template center.

group.description: High-level mesh group name. Grouped templates use center_local and group scale/origin.

write_mesh_potential.description: Output element centroid potentials to mesh_potential.csv.

write_potential_history.description: Output element centroid potential snapshots to potential_history.csv at history_stride intervals.

restart_from.description: Checkpoint input directory used when resume=true. New outputs are still written to output.dir.
